sentiment: The demoscene taught us that constraint breeds beauty — now we build side panels to see everything at once and miss the point of looking.

stories.title: User Interfaces of the Demo Scene
stories.summary: A visual essay exploring the inventive, constrained UI patterns that demoscene creators built to pack maximum expression into minimum resources.

stories.title: Show HN: I was tired of opening 2 tabs for every HN link, so I made a userscript
stories.summary: A userscript that merges Hacker News articles and their comment threads into a single side-by-side view, eliminating the constant tab-switching.

stories.title: Codex Security
stories.summary: OpenAI releases security tooling for Codex, addressing code vulnerability detection and safe execution boundaries for AI-generated code.
